name: SL Corporation
summary: SL Corporation is a global producer and distributor of a diverse range of automotive components, with its operations spanning South Korea and international markets. Based in Gyeongsan, South Korea, the company, established in 1954, provides an extensive product lineup. This includes comprehensive lighting systems such as headlamps, fog lamps, rear lamps, and center high-mounted stop lamps (CHMSLs). Their offerings also extend to chassis parts like auto and manual shifters, park brake levers, pedals, spare tire carriers, fuel filler caps, and tie rod ends. Additionally, SL Corporation manufactures mirror systems, encompassing both exterior and interior rearview mirrors, and integrated front-end modules featuring cooling products, horns, bumper beams, hood latches, and sensors. The company further innovates in advanced vehicle technologies, supplying around-view monitoring systems and head-up displays.
